messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

A. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
B. 'has information page': The subject entity has an information page specified by the object entity.
C. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
